rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the paper's central claim: a hexagonal close-packed polar skyrmion lattice with |Q|≈1 per core stabilized by an out-of-plane electric field, which collapses to a single-domain FE phase at high field. Crucially, the coverage-flip pass demonstrates spontaneous field-induced nucleation of the SkX from a labyrinth phase (L→Sk&L→SkX→FE sequence) without seeding, matching the paper's Fig. 1a mechanism. The T-E phase diagram topology and Kittel scaling (w²∝h, R²=0.96) are also reproduced. Minor gaps include reduced units preventing absolute MV/cm calibration and 2D approximation of the 3D slab, but these do not undermine the core physics.
